resources.string: Dictation: records audio, transcribes, and inserts text into focused fields.
Keeps the dictation overlay running in the background
Tap the floating mic to dictate
Help recognize and write names, acronyms, and specialized terms during dictation and cleanup
One entry per line. Example: OpenWhispr | open whisper, open wisper

The dictionary helps recognize and write names, acronyms, and specialized terms during dictation and cleanup. The form before | is the final spelling; variants after | are pronunciation and recognition hints only. The dictionary stays active with custom instructions. Older one-term lines still work. Example: OpenWhispr | open whisper, open wisper.
